summary: The design adds an authenticated PATCH operation at /api/links/{code} to set or clear expiry, reusing the existing link row, metadata representation, management-token handling, and row lock. Existing HTTP routes and behavior remain unchanged; no schema migration or redirect-path work is needed.
decisions: Update route and method: Add PATCH /api/links/{code}. (agent)
Request value semantics: Require expiresAt; accept a future instant to set expiry and explicit null to remove it. (agent)
Expired and invalid expiries: Reject updates to already expired links with 410 expired and reject non-future values on active links with 400 invalid_expiry. (agent)
Persistence and concurrency: Update the existing nullable expires_at column under the existing pessimistic link-row lock. (agent)
Authentication and throttling: Reuse X-Management-Token verification and the shared wrong-token throttle. (agent)
Expiry limits and redirect path: Add no maximum expiry and do not add work or locking to redirect resolution. (agent)
